show_card_camera: Show the Magic card to your camera to appraise its value.
have_buyer_scan: Have the buyer scan this crest to initiate the transfer for {{price}}.
scan_merchant_qr_desc: Scan the merchant's QR Code to begin a secure transaction.
artifact_added_vault: The artifact has been added to your Vault.
trade_no_cards: You have no artifacts to trade yet.
trade_price_update_error: Could not update the price. Please try again.
trade_code_manual_note: Camera QR scanning isn't wired up yet — paste the code shown on the merchant's screen.
trade_code_not_found: No artifact found for that trade code.
trade_payment_error: Could not complete the purchase. Please try again.
trade_pending_notice: Your trade has been recorded and is awaiting payment confirmation.
trade_cash_success_notice: Cash payment confirmed — the sale is complete.
trade_mp_redirect_notice: A MercadoPago tab has opened — complete your payment there. This trade's status updates automatically once it's confirmed.
bazaar_search_prompt: Search for a card to see who has one for sale.
bazaar_location_denied: Enable location access to see how far away sellers are.
transaction_error: Could not load this trade record.
receipt_disclaimer: Internal receipt generated by MTG Companion — not an SII-authorized electronic invoice ("boleta electrónica").
card_not_found: This artifact could not be found in your Vault.
price_estimate_note: Price set when this card was listed. Live market estimation isn't available yet.
onboarding_intro: Sign in to your account, or create a new one to begin your collection.
onboarding_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
vault_empty: Your Vault is empty. List your first card to begin your collection.
vault_error: Could not open the Vault right now. Please try again.
condition_no_card_content_warning: Couldn't grade condition from this photo (opaque sleeve, or the card wasn't clearly visible) — set it manually.
photo_optional_note: Photo is optional — you can add one later from the card's page.

camera_permission_denied: Camera access denied — allow camera permissions to scan a card.

guided_capture_rejected: That doesn't look like an MTG card — try again.
guided_capture_glare: Glare detected — tilt the card or move away from direct light.
model_not_available: The Companion's sight isn't ready yet — scanning will be available in a future update.
scan_intro: Show the card to your camera — the Companion will identify it automatically.
scan_no_match_banner: Couldn't identify this card automatically — check the fields below.
edit_error: Could not save your changes right now. Please try again.
not_your_card: This artifact isn't in your Vault, so it can't be edited here.
auto_capture_intro: Point the camera at the card and detect it — this confirms it's a Magic card, but can't identify exactly which one yet.
